title: 望洞庭
author: 刘禹锡
intro: On a still autumn night, the moon shines on Dongting Lake, and the water is as smooth as an unpolished mirror. Seen from afar, the island in the middle looks like a little green snail on a silver plate.
analysis: 洞庭湖是中国最有名的大湖之一，湖中有一座君山。这首诗写秋天月夜远望洞庭湖的景色，用了两个漂亮的比喻。第一句写湖光和秋月交相辉映，非常和谐。第二句写湖面没有风，平静得像一面还没打磨过的铜镜——古代的镜子是铜做的，没磨过的镜面朦朦胧胧，正像月光下的湖面。后两句从远处看整个洞庭湖：湖水翠绿，君山青青，就像白银盘子里放着一只青色的田螺。白银盘是月光下的湖面，青螺是湖中的君山，一大一小，一白一青，颜色和形状都很生动。诗人把八百里洞庭写成桌上的一个小摆设，想象奇特，也显出他开阔的胸怀。
analysisEn: Dongting is one of China’s most famous lakes, with a small mountain island, Junshan, in the middle. This poem shows the lake seen from afar on an autumn night, and it rests on two lovely comparisons. The first line: the shimmer of the lake and the autumn moon match each other in perfect harmony. The second: with no wind, the surface is as calm as a bronze mirror that hasn’t been polished. Ancient Chinese mirrors were made of bronze, and an unpolished one gives a soft, hazy reflection — just like the lake under moonlight. The last two lines take in the whole lake from a distance: green water, green hills, like a little green snail lying on a silver plate. The silver plate is the moonlit lake; the snail is Junshan island. One large, one small, one white, one green — the colours and shapes are vivid. The poet turns a vast lake, “eight hundred li” across, into a small ornament on a table. The image is surprising and playful, and it suggests a man with a wide, easy view of the world.
background: Liu Yuxi (772–842) was a Tang poet and official. This poem is traditionally dated to 824, when he passed Dongting Lake on his way to a new post as prefect of Hezhou.
pronunciation: “两相和”的“和”：教材注 hé（和谐），旧注有读 hè（应和）；网站读 hé。“相”读 xiāng；“青螺”的“螺”读 luó。
version: 采用统编教材（三年级上册）版本：“遥望洞庭山水翠”。不少古本和选本作“遥望洞庭山水色”。

lines.py: hú guāng qiū yuè liǎng xiāng hé
lines.lit: The lake’s light and the autumn moon blend in harmony;
lines.en: Lake-light and autumn moon shine in harmony;

lines.py: tán miàn wú fēng jìng wèi mó
lines.lit: the water’s surface, windless, is a mirror not yet polished.
lines.en: no wind on the water — a mirror still unpolished.

lines.py: yáo wàng dòng tíng shān shuǐ cuì
lines.lit: Gazing far at Dongting, hills and water green,
lines.en: From afar, Dongting’s hills and water glow green:

lines.py: bái yín pán lǐ yī qīng luó
lines.lit: in a white silver plate, one green snail.
lines.en: a little green snail on a plate of silver.

words.note: 今天仍叫洞庭湖，是中国第二大淡水湖。

words.en: the water’s surface (here, of the lake)

words.note: 古代铜镜要经常打磨才明亮。

words.en: a silver plate — the moonlit lake

words.note: 比喻湖中的君山；“螺”今天说“田螺”“螺丝”。

imagery.name: 月
imagery.zh: 秋月照在湖上，让湖面变成一只“白银盘”。
imagery.en: The autumn moon on the lake turns the water into a “silver plate”.

imagery.name: 水
imagery.zh: 无风的湖水平静如镜，写出秋夜的安宁。
imagery.en: Windless water, calm as a mirror, shows the peace of the autumn night.

imagery.name: 山
imagery.zh: 湖中的君山被比作小小的青螺，显得玲珑可爱。
imagery.en: Junshan island in the lake becomes a tiny green snail — small and charming.
